title: Úthald
author: Rough-Bat4040
selftext:
[https://windigo2.itch.io/uthald](https://windigo2.itch.io/uthald)A work in progress. A Survival like game I have been messing around with. I use Opus 5 and Fable. and yes i use assets from others because i am not an artist :) I have been working on this for a month and i basically tell the ai every step of the way what i want and how things need to be changed or fixed. it's not just "hey make this game"

  
"Every tool, given enough time, simply becomes part of us. First the hammer, then the calculator, and now AI — each one strange at first, then ordinary, then invisible. In the end, they are all the same thing: ways to create what we alone never could." - Todd
